recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is recommended for FHIR-20771 unless PA later reopens the Person/Practitioner communication semantics or requests additional Person search parameters beyond the separate FHIR-29820 deceased support.
issue_request: FHIR-20771 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request for R5 asking to add Person.deceased, Person.maritalStatus, and Person.communication for Person master-index and cross-role demographic use cases. The final resolution added maritalStatus as a native property, referenced FHIR-29820 for deceased, and added communication as on Patient/RelatedPerson with guidance that Person.communication should not directly update practitioner resources.
initial_application: The request was applied before this reconciliation. Commit 1bf9c6c3a6 added Person.deceased[x], Person.maritalStatus, Person.communication, and communication subelements to source/person/structuredefinition-Person.xml. Commit d6853ff75e applied the related FHIR-29820 deceased-search part by adding Person-deceased and Person-death-date to source/person/bundle-Person-search-params.xml.
additional_context: Earlier no-change issues FHIR-17318 and FHIR-17319 rejected deceased and maritalStatus on Person, but the 2021 PA WGM minutes and later Published Jira disposition superseded that position for R5. source/fhir.ini lists Person as an active approved resource, making the inspected Person source build-scope evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/person/structuredefinition-Person.xml already contains the requested elements, communication subelements, and the note that Person.communication should not be used to update linked practitioner resources. Current source/person/bundle-Person-search-params.xml contains the related deceased search parameters.
